---
title: "Seguros"
---

```{=html}
<div class="tf-page-header"><div><h1>Seguros</h1><div class="tf-muted">Pólizas y coberturas vinculadas al flujo real de Movimientos.</div></div><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button></div>
<div class="tf-actions" style="margin-bottom:1rem"><button id="ins-new" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="button">Nuevo seguro</button><button id="coverage-new" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="button">Registrar cobertura</button><button id="ins-archived-toggle" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button" hidden>Archivados</button></div>

<section class="tf-card"><div class="tf-section-heading"><div><h2>Seguros existentes</h2><div class="tf-muted">La póliza describe la cobertura; los flujos de dinero viven en Movimientos.</div></div></div><div class="tf-table-wrap"><table class="tf-table"><thead><tr><th>Seguro</th><th>Aseguradora</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Inicio</th><th>Fin / renovación</th><th>Estado</th><th>Información</th></tr></thead><tbody id="ins-list"></tbody></table></div></section>

<section class="tf-card" style="margin-top:1rem"><div class="tf-section-heading"><div><h2>Uso del seguro</h2><div class="tf-muted">Costo total = pago personal + cobertura. Si el pago personal es $0 no se crea movimiento.</div></div></div><div class="tf-table-wrap"><table class="tf-table"><thead><tr><th>Fecha</th><th>Seguro</th><th>Servicio</th><th class="tf-num">Total</th><th class="tf-num">Cobertura</th><th class="tf-num">Pagado por mí</th><th>Movimiento</th><th>Información</th></tr></thead><tbody id="coverage-list"></tbody></table></div></section>

<dialog id="ins-editor" class="tf-modal-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Seguro</div><h2 id="ins-editor-title">Nuevo seguro</h2></div><button id="ins-editor-close" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Cerrar</button></div><form id="ins-form" class="tf-form-grid"><input id="ins-id" type="hidden"><div class="tf-field"><label>Tipo</label><select id="ins-type"><option value="health">Salud</option><option value="vehicle">Vehículo</option><option value="equipment">Equipo</option><option value="other">Otro</option></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Aseguradora</label><input id="ins-provider" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Nombre / póliza</label><input id="ins-name" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Prima mensual ($)</label><input id="ins-premium" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Día de pago</label><input id="ins-payment-day" type="number" min="1" max="31" value="1"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Recordar (días antes)</label><input id="ins-reminder" type="number" min="0" max="30" value="3"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Inicio vigencia</label><input id="ins-start" type="date"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Fin / renovación</label><input id="ins-end" type="date"></div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Guardar seguro</button><button id="ins-cancel" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Cancelar</button></div></form></dialog>

<dialog id="coverage-editor" class="tf-modal-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Uso del seguro</div><h2>Registrar cobertura</h2></div><button id="coverage-close" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Cerrar</button></div><form id="coverage-form" class="tf-form-grid"><div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Seguro</label><select id="coverage-policy"></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha</label><input id="coverage-date" type="date" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Servicio / referencia</label><input id="coverage-description" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Pago realizado por mí ($)</label><input id="coverage-paid" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Cobertura del seguro ($)</label><input id="coverage-covered" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Costo total</label><input id="coverage-total" type="text" readonly value="$0,00"></div><div class="tf-field" id="coverage-account-wrap"><label>Cuenta de pago</label><select id="coverage-account"></select></div><label class="tf-check tf-span-2"><input id="coverage-has-invoice" type="checkbox"> Registrar factura / IVA sobre mi pago</label><div id="coverage-invoice-fields" class="tf-span-2 tf-form-grid" hidden><div class="tf-field"><label>Número de factura</label><input id="coverage-invoice-number"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>IVA incluido en mi pago ($)</label><input id="coverage-vat" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div></div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-muted">Si el pago personal es $0, la cuenta se deshabilita y no se crea movimiento. El uso del seguro sí queda registrado.</div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Registrar cobertura</button><button id="coverage-cancel" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Cancelar</button></div></form></dialog>

<dialog id="ins-detail-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Seguro</div><h2 id="ins-detail-title">Detalle</h2></div><button id="ins-detail-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar</button></div><div id="ins-detail-body"></div></dialog>
<dialog id="coverage-detail-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Cobertura</div><h2 id="coverage-detail-title">Detalle</h2></div><button id="coverage-detail-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar</button></div><div id="coverage-detail-body"></div></dialog>

<script type="module" src="js/insurance.js?v=1.0.86"></script>
```
